puzzles.name: Security Desk Combination Drawer
puzzles.description: A heavy steel lockbox drawer secured with a 4-digit mechanical rotary tumbler.
hints: Inspect the Security Log on the desk and look at the frozen clock on the wall.
The guard's log states: 'Shift lock code is set to the mirror minute of incident time plus our sector prefix 7'.
The wall clock stopped exactly at 09:47. The sector prefix is 7, and the minute hands point to 47 inverted (mirror 490). The code is 7490.
puzzles.rewardMessage: The lock clicks open. Inside lies Keycard Alpha and an old magnetic audio reel labeled 'Sterling - Loop Log 01'.

puzzles.name: Chrono-Resonance Specimen Array
puzzles.description: Three pressurized containment cylinders holding temporal isotopes: Chronite (Alpha), Flux-Core (Gamma), and Tachyon (Beta). They must be energized in order of atomic decay rate to stabilize the containment field.
hints: Check Dr. Evelyn Vane's handwritten lab notes on the corkboard beside the centrifuge.
The note reads: 'Always calibrate starting with the highest temporal half-life (Chronite-Alpha), followed by the dampening field (Flux-Gamma), ending with the volatile particle (Tachyon-Beta)'.
Select the cylinders in the order: Alpha -> Gamma -> Beta.
puzzles.rewardMessage: The chronometric coils stabilize with a harmonious hum! The magnetic seal on the Observation Corridor bulkhead releases.

puzzles.name: Project Chronos Classified Vault
puzzles.description: A reinforced archival vault containing the restricted incident dossiers. The alphanumeric keypad requires an authorization code.
hints: Look at the project report index card on the reading table and the ultraviolet lamp imprint.
The classification prefix is 'ASTRA' and the safe index references Incident File 84, sub-clause 2.
Combine the prefix and the numbers: ASTRA-842.
puzzles.rewardMessage: The heavy vault door swings open with a low hiss. Inside is the classified dossier on Dr. Arthur Sterling's secret contingency plan.

puzzles.name: Temporal Alignment Sequencer
puzzles.description: The central timeline terminal requires reconstructing the true sequence of events that triggered the 10-minute recursion loop at 09:47.
hints: Review your investigation notebook under the Timeline and Transcripts tabs.
The timeline began with the Tachyon Containment Test, followed by the power surge, Sterling's manual lock, Vane's attempt to cut the core, and finally the resonance collapse at 09:47.
The correct chronological order is: 1. Experiment Initiation -> 2. Core Power Spike -> 3. Sterling System Override -> 4. Vane Emergency Scram -> 5. Temporal Field Collapse.
puzzles.rewardMessage: Timeline sequence verified! The Master Override Terminal is unlocked. The final choices for the facility's fate are now available.
